data: Fantastic game, highly addictive and even better with friends
its a great game with great mechanics a fun variety of characters and truly exceptional replay ability
Awesome game, very addicting gameplay loop
Great game and love this developer
The game seems to keep getting worse and worse with every update

game is good but if you want to buy a finished game then dont get it. we are in an early access balance phase where large changes will be made regularly. there are questionyable elements of balance or design currently but the game is very purromising and it is easy to have clawnfidence that it will end up in a good place given these devs made basically the only good roguelike deckbuilder.

I definitely enjoyed the first STS and this second one started off really well. I believe there is a bit of tuning needed to be done especially as you go through the ascension levels. I understand that the game will be difficult the higher the ascension but the nerfs the developers have been putting into the characters and their builds is making the game not playable unless you get godly card combos. Like how does a phase two of one of the bosses do 60 damage by turn 3 of the phase and I'm expected to either blow it up before it gets to that or have enough defense to block it. If you manage to survive it next one would be 70 damage I assume or some debuff/buff action. Also multiplayer scaling is crazy, at best the player output damage is a linear increase of x (how ever many players in the lobby) while the mobs (regular, elites, and bosses) increase exponentially offensively and defensively so playing as a duo is tough in general. This is just my rant for the game. It is still early access so I know this isn't the final product and will look forward to more updates and releases but as is I can not 100% recommend but I still play and try to enjoy the content (sometimes) so my "no" is not a concrete thing (will change maybe or post another review down the road).

*April 19,2026*
Don't even think about making balance adjustments until you can beat A10 with a win rate near 50%.
If F2 turns out to be useless and BETA testing offers no valuable insights, we'll have no choice but to leave a bad review. The quality of these patch changes is so lousy that it makes us wonder if you've ever actually made a game called 'Slay The Spire'.
*June 7，2026*
I'm still confused, and at this point mostly just disappointed. Your roadmap mentions a new map for Area 2, another for Area 3, a new final boss area, and even a new playable character.
With that much core content still missing, I don't understand why you're already so focused on balance instead of finishing the game first.
All of those additions are going to reshape the experience anyway, so spending this much effort on balance right now just feels premature. The whole thing feels backwards, and it's getting harder and harder not to feel like you still don't understand your own priorities.
Me and my friends beat Ascention 10 in Co-op every time. The doormaker has wonderful eyes, pearly white teeth, and some nice nails. --- Please add time-eater tho.
Solid sequel to the first game, each run is unique (within reason) challenging alone and with friends. Highly recommend for people new to the deck building genre.

I've heard it said about Slay the Spire 1 "if it had been invented 3000 years ago, people would still play & talk about it, like chess." And this game, while still early access and will require a number of iterations before it feels like it's in as good a spot balance-wise, is a perfect evolution of the first game. All the basics are the same, but all the details are different. Every single enemy and boss is brand new, while the returning playable characters are familiar yet work in new and exciting ways. I've been playing the crap out of this game and it's a blast.
Mint game, super difficult. If you're looking for a challenge that you can come back to again and again, this is the game for you.

Very addicting, well balanced game with great progression. Perfectly expands on the first game keeping the things that made it great and finding new way to challenge each play through. I can't wait for the full release to see how they continue to improve the game.
of course, the only roguelike that can beat slay the spire is slay the spire 2. the best got bester

Still one of the most genre define game in the market, and with even more mechanics and better visual theme (though some are not finished). Games feels the mostly same but vastly different from the 1st one. The foundation is still round based card game but developers added a lot more mechanics into it. The battles requires more thinking than before because the stats in game are more aggressively given the the 1st game. Nonetheless worth you spending hundreds of hours on trials and errors and achieve higher difficulty.

Great game and love this developer. The feedback mechanism is broken on steam machine, so I'm leaving my feedback here instead. Audio and music is very glitchy on steam machine, multiple sounds at once causes full sound skips, and it's annoying enough that I now only play on mute. Would love for this to be fixed!

I loved slay the spire 1 then when i found out there was a slay the spire 2 I told all the friends who would listen to me. I love this game, the one thing i hate is the hunter killer who always shows up on a silent run with a shiv build just to ruin my day

I bought this game the second it came out and am glad to see frequent content and balance updates!
Give me back my two cost voltaic and my life is yours :)

Also, check out the modding scene! Downfall is great!

This game is absolutely fantastic and the updates adding new things are frequent.
People hate-reviewing because they don't like a card change update should be ashamed. Nothing is set in stone.

Game is cool, but too easy. Whole time thought there was up to A20... got stuck at 10 for a few days really wondering how on earth it could keep getting more demanding... just to find out 10 was the max and we won.

Changing my review because I see the vision now. It's a fun game if you're a glutton for punishment and really enjoy a challenge. You do have to rely heavily on getting good cards and items. The wrong type of encounter at the wrong time can still ruin an otherwise great run. It's frustrating and time consuming, but it's not unbeatable. Some characters feel easier to play than others, and some items can really change the outcome of a run. It just requires a lot of wrestling with the randomization.

I'd recommend it to hardcore fans of the genre, but the negative reviews are entirely valid. The balancing could use some improvement.

Received this game as a gift. Did not think I would like it. Even Steam said it did not look like other games I've played. Did the obligatory co-op play with the gift giver and was immediately HOOKED! You can easily start playing and find 3-5 hours just disappeared.
This game is now one of my favorites! I cannot recommend it highly enough.

I like Slay the Spire 2 better than Slay the Spire 1. The multiplayer option has been a game changer since my friends are very good at this game and I am not as much. It's made it a lot more fun and accessible to me!

I got Slay the Spire 2 as a gift from someone I’ll probably never forget
Every time I open this game it reminds me of a person who was genuinely kind to me at a time I needed it more than I realized.

Maybe life got busy maybe things changed maybe we just drifted apart — but I still appreciate this gift and the thought behind it.

To the girl who gave me this game thank you
I hope life is treating you gently and I hope you know you made someone smile for much longer than you expected.

And about the game itself — it’s amazing already
Beautiful art addictive gameplay and somehow now it carries a memory too.

As a huge Mario fan, the fact that this is my favorite game over titles like Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle (10 Mil units sold), Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with the dlc (71.53 Mil units sold), and Mario Odyssey (30.8 Mil units sold) is impressive, not including the fact that this game is only in early access and it was still my favorite upon early release. I have over 400 hours on this game and still could not fathom over the idea of not being able to play more, despite not even having experienced the up and coming 6th character and alternate act 2 (and hopefully the FINAL final boss, a 7th character, and an alternate act 3).

This game has amazing music at every turn, already great animations that are getting improved upon, and fantastic art (RIP scrub daddy abrasive and cute shadow shield). The lore in this game is great and the fanart and community is amazing. It is so easy to find any type of game in the StS2 Discord, and I can not wait to play with my friends when we have the time (it's killing me how we are all busy at the worst times).

11/10 never stop MegaCrit
Absolutely LOVE this game! 10/10 with friends and its even fun when you increase the difficulty. Though it is frustrating, it def makes the win better.

I usually only leave 1 word reviews on games but this is truly special. They have absolutely knocked it out of the park again. Another 10/10 with the lens that it is EA so there are naturally a few quirks.

A huge step-up from the first game, especially when it comes to it's art direction.

Even someone who "isn't into card games" would probably really enjoy this game, I'm very glad I decided to get into the series with the first game.
It's only been out for one week and I already have 30 hours in the game. I'm incredibly exited for what they have yet to show.

The addiction..... It's all consuming.....

Multiplayer is loads of fun and has brought 3 of my friends to the game who had not played the first game.

This is a great game. They need to make a mobile version with cross-progression and it will be perfect.

So I like/hate it. So close to the goodness of the first one.

However, if you aren't counting every card it's fairly impossible and even if you do, sometimes there's nothing you can do with a run. The first one is superior. At least if you counted you could do ok at worst. And if you get a nice synergy going and destroy, satisfying. Not here. Purists, hard cores will maybe appreciate the additional challenge?

My other complaint is there are characters that just have no juice. Here are the same card choices that don't work. Please choose from the same 3 cards. AGAIN.

Get ready for bosses that armor every round, defuf your already weak ass shit every round. I'm sure theres some magic combo to overcome but I didn't do the study guide sir. Oh cool. I have a total of 12 block available meanwhile the boss gonna hit me for 27 and the 2 minions 7 and 9. FUN! Is there some block card + buff + debuff I missed along the way? Maybe the key is unlocking some achievement card? Who knows. Anyone play testing this?

Also, plays great on my SteamDeck.
Extremely addictive game, you will sweat a lot in order to survive and unlock ascensions. Looking forward to the finished version so I can finally defeat the architect.
Fun game with or without friends, I was pretty against it at first and then i tried it and want to play with my boyfriend all the time.

It's a great game that is in early access stage, things are not balanced, but with time it will be great. I've looked through recent negative review and they are mostly about balancing. Early access is here to help with balancing. I hope devs won't be discouraged by the review bomb and look through the negative comments as some of them tell what issues they have with the game(most of them about Doormaker boss and there's balancing issue(which is expected cause early access)). If you want full balanced game experience it's better to wait for the game to exit the early access.
Very Fun and Quirky rogue like card game that you can relax and enjoy with some friends for a few hours.

Slay the Spire 2 builds on the wonderful base of the first game. Building a deck, upgrade and transforming cards, gathering relics, potions, and knowledge of how to tackle each fight is the name of the game. Animations are beautiful and a nice upgrade from the first game. And 4 player co-op! What a blast!

Great game. I played in the beta version so sometimes the balance felt off, but it provided me so far with 480 hours of fun while juggling other work on the side. It still feels a bit overtuned on the enemy damages in higher ascensions and some runs are completely unwinnable no matter what you do if you don't have a specific card or if the game isn't feeling generous to you. But overall it's extremely fun and you start to pick up on combos and patterns as they come. 
I do wish there's a way to undo certain moves as long as damages haven't been exchanged within the same round, just in case you misclick on something. But it's been fun!
Every game feels different and hundreds of hours later I'm still hooked. Definitely a fun challenge and you better get used to losing, but it makes each win taste so good lol.

So, I LOVE this game. I've played so many hours of this alone and with friends... BUT - holy **** the act 3 Aeonglass boss is legit impossible. Like it makes it so frustrating and unfun that when we get through every other fight in Ascension 10 only to see that one of the bosses is the Aeonglass it's like... okay well GG's. Like two bosses isn't already nearly impossible, you add a boss who literally has tons of HP, gives you status cards that do damage, does outrageous damage. It would take such a specific build to counter it and the odds you make that build or then end up running into that boss are slim. Like give the people hope of beating ascension 10 after some of these changes plllssssss

Just as good if not better than the first game. Cool new cards and classes.

Pretty much improves on everything from the first game, feels like the perfect sequel. The best deck-based roguelite by far.
Great value for fans of the genre, but if you're new to the genre and it's on sale, I'd say it's definitely worth a try.
best rougelike, ngl worth the money it stays fresh and I think i would jack off a monkey for more content or a 25th hour in my day to play this game.
Gorgeous animation and art style over the previous one, more characters, more varied builds and coop that is great fun. If you like roguelikes, grab it.
Recent updates have made the game unplayable. I really like this game and I've played a lot, the recent updates have ruined it for me. I get one good run every 10, no matter how well I play.

This game is wildly addicting, I have a legion go that I probably spent 3/4 of my hours playing. It doesn't take high specs to run smoothly and it's become the default game I go to when I sit down.

It's the perfect balance of cozy with some strategy, quick rounds for a short gaming session, and enough action to be engaging.
Good fun. Can follow community on Youtube and there are some good content creators on there. Also fun to play with friends.

Incredible game. So much replayability, and multiplayer is a blast! I'm new to deck builders and roguelikes, but as soon as I got this game I logged 9 hours.. Oops. Super addicting, get it!
I really enjoy this game for what it is. I really like testing out different combos and decks. This game I can spend 10-15 hours doing the same thing and not get board.

It's so fun that I could not tell I spend 2 whole day playing that how addicting this game is. If you want a fun rougelike card game you want to spend hours play and never getting bored this is the game for you. Not only are they just in the early stages so new content are still coming and it has multiplayer, allowing up to 4 people (I don't have to friend to play with) but still very cool.
